mn27:13.6: pharusaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti yā sā vācā nelā kaṇṇasukhā pemanīyā hadayaṅgamā porī bahujanakantā bahujanamanāpā tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.

mn27:26.4: idampi vuccati brāhmaṇa tathāgatapadaṃ itipi tathāgatanisevitaṃ itipi tathāgatārañjitaṃ itipi.
mn27:26.5: ettāvatā kho brāhmaṇa ariyasāvako niṭṭhaṅgato hoti
mn27:26.6: sammāsambuddho bhagavā svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo supaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅghoti.
mn27:26.7: ettāvatā kho brāhmaṇa hatthipadopamo vitthārena paripūro hoti.
mn27:27.1: evaṃ vutte jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn27:27.2: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama abhikkantaṃ bho gotama
mn27:27.3: seyyathāpi bho gotama nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti evamevaṃ bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito
mn27:27.4: esāhaṃ bhagavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca
mn27:27.5: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṅgatanti.
